$comment: Single source of truth for OBP lawful-basis decisions. Canonical decision order (both Go platform/lawful-basis and Python platform/basis-matrix must follow it, proven by matrix tests): (1) normalize purpose aliases and defaults; (2) unknown purpose -> prohibited; (3) hard prohibitions (untargeted_mass_id always; rbr_public without LE); (4) rbr_public LE without acknowledged DPiA -> requires_dpia; (5) special category without DPiA -> requires_dpia; (6) special category without consent (non-LE) -> requires_consent; (7) purpose rule (consent / consent+dpia); (8) permitted. Retention: RetentionMax = clamp(requested, cap); requested <= 0 stays 0; prohibited -> 0. retention_days here is the standard request callers pass.
